nodes.text:
BREAKING: The Nigeria Centre for Disease Control (NCDC) declares that Nigeria is not at risk yet from the new COVID outbreak, the Human Metapneumovirus (HMPV) infection.

In China, thousands of people, especially children, had been hospitalised due to the infection.
